citations.excerpt: It was on the feast of St. John Baptist , 1559, that the statute took effect which abolished throughout England the old worship, and set up the new.

facts.value: Under Elizabeth I, an Act of Supremacy restored royal authority over the church, with the queen as Supreme Governor, and an Act of Uniformity prescribed a revised prayer book.

citations.excerpt: An Act of Supremacy restored to the crown the authority over the church held by Henry VIII.
but Elizabeth rejected the title of Supreme Head, and used that of Supreme Governor
An Act of Uniformity prescribed the use of the prayer-book of 1552 in a revised form
